key_highlights: ASX falls sharply on Wall Street decline and oil spike to $US101/barrel amid escalating Iran conflict; Goldman flags $120 upside
RBA policy perceived as choosing recession; business conditions weakest since pandemic; home buyer sentiment collapses
AUD shocker looms as oil-driven inflation pressures and China-Trump tensions intensify
Iron ore weakness spreads, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; offset by WA gold discoveries and copper strength
Bathla collapse ripples through private credit market, raising systemic risk concerns
NSW budget faces massive stamp duty hit; high-end property prices falling while affordable segment resilient
Austal jumps on $1.9B bid; WA gold sector active with multiple high-grade hits and drill-out funding

sectors.trend: Mixed: iron ore weakness spreads pressuring major miners, but WA gold discoveries (Auric, Golden Dragon, Forrestania, Gateway) and copper strength (Flagship) provide sector pockets of strength. Critical mineral for solar panels sees price boom.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face headwinds from iron ore softness; gold juniors (AUC.AX, GDR.AX, FRS.AX, GWP.AX) and copper names (FLG.AX) offer relative strength. Diversify away from pure iron ore exposure.

sectors.trend: Oil at $US101 with Goldman $120 target on Iran war escalation. NSW power supply concerns and data centre demand strain grid. WA energy policy under political fire.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SXW.AX benefit from oil spike. Power generators face demand surge from AI data centres (33, 44). Energy transition narrative challenged by data centre load.

sectors.trend: RBA recession stance pressures lending growth. Bathla collapse signals private credit stress. ATO vs Big Tech tax fight adds regulatory uncertainty. Qantas $35M payout highlights corporate cost pressures.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin compression risk from rate cuts and credit stress. Private credit exposure (via fund managers) warrants caution. REITs pressured by higher rates but housing demand soft.

sectors.trend: Home buyer sentiment collapses; high-end property sees steepest falls while affordable segment resilient. NSW stamp duty hit reduces budget revenue. Housing 'collapse' warnings dismissed as bad faith by some analysts.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) and homebuilders (MPL.AX, WBC.AX) face demand softness. Consumer discretionary under pressure from recession fears. Staples (WES.AX, WOW.AX) relatively defensive.

sectors.trend: AI data centre buildout at coal plants signals energy-tech convergence. Austal $1.9B bid signals M&A activity. OpenAI 'AGI era' declaration drives global tech sentiment. Roblox guidance cuts signal growth reset.
sectors.implications: ASX tech names limited but data centre infrastructure (SGH.AX, VNT.AX) benefit. Austal (AUS.AX) M&A premium. Global tech volatility (RBLX, AAPL) affects sentiment spillover.

key_themes: Geopolitical oil shock: Iran war drives Brent to $101, Goldman sees $120; TACO trade triggered
RBA recession policy: rate cuts chosen over growth support, business conditions at pandemic lows
AUD vulnerability: oil-driven inflation vs growth slowdown creates policy dilemma
Commodity bifurcation: iron ore weak, gold/copper/critical minerals strong
Private credit contagion: Bathla collapse tests market resilience
Housing bifurcation: luxury falls, affordable resilient; sentiment at multi-year lows
Energy transition vs AI demand: data centres strain grid, challenge decarbonisation narrative
China-Trump friction: trade and geopolitical risk to Australian export earnings

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil price spike / Iran war escalation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; favour oil producers (WDS.AX, WLE.AX) over refiners; monitor Goldman $120 target
Shift to quality earnings, dividend payers; reduce cyclical exposure; monitor NAB/CBA loan growth data
Review fund-of-funds and alternative credit exposure; favour listed equities over unlisted private credit
Hedge USD-denominated liabilities; favour export earners (BHP.AX, CSL.AX) as natural AUD hedge
Reduce pure iron ore exposure; rotate to gold/copper miners; monitor China stimulus signals
Avoid high-end REITs; favour affordable-segment and industrial REITs; monitor CoreLogic data

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight oil & gas producers on $100+ oil
opportunities.rationale: Iran war escalation and Goldman $120 target support sustained elevated oil; WDS and WLE benefit directly

opportunities.recommendation: Rotate into WA gold and copper juniors
opportunities.rationale: Multiple high-grade hits (Auric, Golden Dragon, Gateway) and copper strength (Flagship) signal sector upcycle; safe-haven bid on gold
M&A premium likely; shipbuilding sector benefits from global reindustrialisation and defence spending

opportunities.recommendation: Favour defensive dividend payers in recession
opportunities.rationale: RBA recession stance and weak business conditions favour income strategies; CSL, WES, WOW offer resilience

defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore weakness spreading; China-Trump tensions threaten demand; BHP/RIO/FMG face margin pressure

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim private credit and alternative fund exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Bathla collapse signals contagion risk in private credit; liquidity may dry up in stress

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD downside; favour export-earning ASX names
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD shocker looms; BHP, CSL, FMG earn in USD providing natural currency hedge

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid high-end residential REITs and homebuilders
defensive_moves.rationale: Steepest price falls at luxury end; buyer sentiment collapsed; NSW stamp duty hit reduces transaction volume

market_outlook.short_term: ASX under pressure: oil spike inflates import costs, RBA recession stance weighs on growth, Bathla contagion spooks credit markets. Expect ^AXJO to test support. Oil at $101+ supports energy names but hurts transport and consumer. 1-3 month outlook: volatile, risk-off bias.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month: RBA easing cycle supports rate-sensitive sectors (REITs, property) if inflation normalises. Gold/copper structural demand intact. AI data centre buildout creates multi-year energy and infrastructure capex cycle. China-Trump trade friction is key swing factor for iron ore and AUD. Housing bifurcation likely to persist.

RBA next meeting and rate path
China stimulus response to Trump trade pressure
Bathla fallout and private credit market stability
NSW/State budget outcomes and stamp duty changes
watch_list: Iron ore 62% Fe price and China import data
RBA cash rate and inflation forecast
CoreLogic house price index (high-end vs affordable)
ASX 200 sector rotation (energy vs materials vs financials)
